Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full outage payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Outage status","status":"restoring","headline":"Crews are on site restoring power","area":"Maple Grove · ZIP 55311","cause":"Storm — downed line","affectedText":"1,240 customers affected","etaText":"Est. restore by 6:45 PM","updatedText":"Updated 4 min ago","crew":"Crew #17 on site","steps":[{"label":"Outage detected","state":"done","timeText":"3:02 PM"},{"label":"Crew dispatched","state":"done","timeText":"3:40 PM"},{"label":"On site — repairing","state":"current","timeText":"5:15 PM"},{"label":"Power restored","state":"todo"}],"submitText":"Text me when power is back","submitValue":"Please text me when power is restored"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Outage status'.
- 'status' (string, optional): one of investigating | outage | restoring | restored. Drives the hero color + label (investigating/restoring = amber, outage = red, restored = green). Defaults to 'outage'.
- 'headline' (string, optional): one short sentence under the status.
- 'area' (string, optional): the affected location, e.g. neighborhood + ZIP.
- 'cause' (string, optional): what caused the outage.
- 'affectedText' (string, optional): e.g. '1,240 customers affected'.
- 'etaText' (string, optional): estimated restore time.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): freshness stamp, e.g. 'Updated 4 min ago'.
- 'crew' (string, optional): crew status line.
- 'steps' (array, optional): the restoration track, each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'state' ('done'|'current'|'todo'), 'timeText' (string, optional) }. Order them chronologically. If omitted, a default track is derived from 'status'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): action-button label, e.g. 'Text me when power is back'. Omit for no button.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back when the button is tapped; defaults to the label.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
